Name: Sir Robin
Location: Random encounter (Monty Python parody) — one of Arthur's knights, first encounter (rndholy1)
VoiceType: Robin is the least brave of Arthur's knights — nervy
AuditionLineA: Sir Robin, at your service.
AuditionLineB: That doesn't belong to you.
AuditionLineC: You're not going to try to hurt me are you?

Name: Sir Launcelot
Location: Random encounter (Monty Python parody) — one of Arthur's knights, first encounter (rndholy1)
VoiceType: Launcelot is the brash
AuditionLineA: Sir Launcelot, at your service.
AuditionLineB: You looking for a fight?
AuditionLineC: Here now! Your hands are ice cold!

Name: Dex
AuditionLineA:
[As you approach the cryogenic chamber, you see an attractive naked man sprawled on the floor. He draws
 his knees up and hugs them against his chest. He sits there for several moments, staring blankly ahead as his body
 quakes and his teeth chatter. Gradually, he seems to calm down.]
AuditionLineB: Miria, you need a man who's in the same league as you. You know, one like me.
AuditionLineC:
Of course you don't mind. Thanks, babe. [He steps past you, gently slapping your rump, and opens a nearby locker.
 He casually dresses himself in a finely tailored suit, then pockets the locker's contents. Utilizing a pocket comb, he
 begins to sculpt and style his slicked dark hair with the quick precision of a seasoned pro.] I don't think I've seen
 you around, doll, and I doubt I'd forget a face like yours. Name's, Dex, but I'm sure you know that. Mind if I ask yours?

Name: Sergeant Cat Jules
AuditionLineA:
[As you approach the cryogenic chamber, you see a slender, naked black man sprawled on the floor.
 His muscular body is still shaking from the icy, cold water. He looks up at you as you approach.]
AuditionLineB: Yeah, ain't we all. What am I gonna to do now though?
AuditionLineC:
I used to be the guard for one of the genetics labs. They were messing with human and feline DNA.
 Trying to make something with the best of both worlds, I suppose. And that's where yours truly comes in.
 [Cat flashes you his toothy grin.] They wanted a volunteer for one of their projects. It was for scouts and the like, supposed to
 make you more agile and flexible. I liked the sound of that *leers*. Anyway, they gave me this shot, put me under, and
 the next thing I knew, I had these teeth, and I felt.... sharper? Kind of predatory.
Notes: concat_bug=none; forked script; untagged, vanilla RPU baseline text; audit: claude/audit/vock-fo2/epac11_va_tagging.md

Name: Kitsune
AuditionLineA: Her eyes are different colors. One of them brown as malmbrick, the other bright green.
AuditionLineB: Whoa. That had to be some trip. Are you alright?
AuditionLineC:
How do you know for sure you're gonna be taken someplace special after you sleep the big sleep? I come from a
 tribe that believes in the afterlife and prophecies, but from a pragmatic standpoint we're all just a bunch of organic
 machines that think and talk and feel because of flesh and chemical components. What if there's nothing after you die -- we
 shut down like computers -- and this is all you've got?

Name: Badger
AuditionLineA: :::He belches loudly:: Whaddya want?
AuditionLineB: Thanks. I have more questions.
AuditionLineC: I can get them. They're pretty protective of their info, and they've got some serious ice protecting their machines. Are you sure you want me to go after them?

Name: Chip
AuditionLineA: Ooh, my guts... ow, ow, ow.
AuditionLineB: Thanks for all your help, buddy.
AuditionLineC: What's the matter with me? I'll tell you: It's that I got drunk last week, started gambling with Lao Chou, and lost. I was so blind drunk that I bet my spleen. Now he has it, and I need it back.

Name: Dragon
AuditionLineA: How may I be of assistance?
AuditionLineB: I will be waiting for you, Lo Pan.
AuditionLineC: Yet, in a formalized fighting environment, you cannot dispute that you have entered this arena of your own choosing. Once you have so entered, should you not abide by its rules?

Name: Dr. Fung
AuditionLineA: This is Dr. Fung.
AuditionLineB: It's all I want to offer. So long.
AuditionLineC: We have dermal implants, which protect against concussive damage. If you like that work, we can add a single enhancement to it. We also have Phoenix implants, which protect against heat-based attacks, and which also have an upgrade available. If you're interested in the upgrades, you will of course have to wait until the initial set has been installed. And before you ask, yes, you CAN have all four operations.

Name: Wong Yi Tze
AuditionLineA: May I assist you with something?
AuditionLineB: Well, that's that. Let me ask you something else.
AuditionLineC: What happened? I'd say he lost his mind. During his experiments he stumbled upon something which I admit was rather remarkable, but it was also extremely dangerous and in no way related to the goals of the Shi. But that did not matter to Dr. Sheng. He became obsessed with his creation and since his experiments were deemed too dangerous to continue here, he decided to take them elsewhere. He left on sabbatical and never returned. That is when I stepped up to fill his position.

Name: Matthew
AuditionLineA: Hello,
AuditionLineB: Nothing. Me come back later.
AuditionLineC: Several months ago we came across a group known as the Enclave. Much to our surprise their level of technology surpassed even our own. We found this quite disturbing and considered contacting them. However, we decided on a more cautious course of action until we could determine exactly who the Enclave was, and the underlying purpose of their organization.

Name: Vikki Goldman & Juan Cruz
AuditionLineA: Him: Hi! I'm Juan Cruz! Her: And I'm Vikki Goldman! Both: We're celebrities! And we endorse Hubology! Both: Please note that any similarities between us and people or institutions, living or dead, is entirely coincidental.
AuditionLineB: Err... right. I have more questions.
AuditionLineC: Him: Dead? Ha ha! Perhaps. We like to think that he aligned all his neurodynes and went to join the Star Father. Her: We have extensive use of his jotted notes and barely-begun manuscripts to spread the word of the Hub. Him: For example, we found a scrap that said: "2 doz. eggs/Milk/TP". Obviously this is significant. It needs to be heard.

Name: Ken Lee
AuditionLineA: What would you like, friend?
AuditionLineB: What's the history of the place?
AuditionLineC: The Emperor remains hidden from prying eyes. It is my job to act as the Emperor's screen. However, you have proven yourself to be a friend to the Shi. I believe I can trust you with our secrets. In the back room, you will find the forcefield to the large computer has been turned off. Enter the password "CSPDMSHR-Shih-huang-ti-X9372" and you will find yourself connected to the Emperor Computer. I hope this will prove useful to you.

Name: Lao Chou
AuditionLineA: Greetings! Welcome to my shop, Flying Dragon 8.
AuditionLineB: What do you mean by 'considerable good fortune?'
AuditionLineC:
But there was salvation. After weeks of drifting, the sub finally came to rest out in the shallow waters of the
 San Francisco bay. This city became our new home. We eventually restored the Shi-Huang-Ti; its targeting systems, its
 weapons. It has enough firepower to blow any potential invaders out of the water. So even if you got that old tanker
 running, it wouldn't get far, as the submarine will destroy any non-Chinese vessel that sails through the bay.

Name: Lo Pan
AuditionLineA: What do you want?
AuditionLineB: Sounds like too much trouble. Bye.
AuditionLineC: I'm Lo Pan. I'm also the "sworn enemy" of the Dragon. Why he insists on having a sworn enemy is beyond me. I just fight as well as him, and I think he's weak-hearted and allows others to live under his shadow. We're enemies because we have the same fighting style, and whoever wins will be the one who carries the tradition.

Name: AHS-7
VoiceType: AHS-7 is the second-in-command of the Hubologist enclave — a true believer
AuditionLineA: You. State your business.
AuditionLineB: Simply use the holodisk Juan and Vikki provided to you and check out the Glossary.
AuditionLineC: I am AHS-7, the second in command of this facility. Before you ask: AHS stands for Aligned Hub Seeker, which means that I have cleared seven levels of neurodynes from my spirit. This means that I am more enlightened and closer to the hub of the Great Wheel than you. And this means that you will tell me what you want here. Now.

Name: AHS-9
AuditionLineA: You blaspheme the Hub's name! You must die!
AuditionLineB: I'm working on it. I have some questions.
AuditionLineC: The Enclave are a remnant of the past - a neurodyne that has yet to be aligned. They have hidden bases all over the shards of old California, and their strongest stronghold is off to the west, over the waters.

Name: Ron Meyers
AuditionLineA: What the hell do you want? I don't speak to anyone unless they're friends or good people. Do something for one of my buddies and then come talk to me.
AuditionLineB: What's an IFF transponder and a FOB?
AuditionLineC: How do you pilot this rig? Fill 'er up with some gas - try the Hubologists or the Shi after you've taken care of everything else - and press the button. The computer will take care of the rest, if it's still working. It'll sail right out to the oil rig - unless that old sub blows it up. But at least you won't have to worry about the Enclave firing at you, because you've got the IFF transponder. Just make sure you've got what you need to access everything: FOB, working computer, and fuel. Easy enough, huh?

Name: Suze
VoiceType: Suze is a young woman who wandered into the tunnels below San Francisco while Badger
AuditionLineA: Did Badger send you? I knew he would. I'm so relieved.
AuditionLineB: You saved my life. I'll answer any questions you have.
AuditionLineC: It's kind of stupid, really. I was just exploring because Badger was on the computer and I went downstairs and got lost and then next thing you know, I'm surrounded by monsters. Good thing you came along.

Name: Brain (Mole Rat)
AuditionLineA: You are even more foolish than most of your kind to cross me. Now you must die.
AuditionLineB: I killed one of your drones and took it from his still warm corpse.
AuditionLineC:
Well, once you get a Hydroelectric Magnetosphere Regulator from Vault City, bring it back
 to the reactor. Then you can try to convince that pompous slug Festus to install the part, or use the
 repair robot to install the part, or you could even install the part yourself, of course - so long as
 someone does it we'll be all right.

Name: Festus
AuditionLineA: Aren't you just as stupid as they get? Hah, hah, hah.
AuditionLineB: Do you smell something? Something foul? I better leave. Goodbye.
AuditionLineC:
Thanks for getting the data we needed from Vault City to optimize this leaky old beast.
 You're a sly one, no denying it, by cracky. Almost as good a job as I could have done myself.
 'Course... if'n you wanna actually *finish* the dang job, just use that disk on the Robot Control Terminal.
 Understand me? Well, OK then.

Name: Gordon
AuditionLineA: I have no time for stupid people.
AuditionLineB: Shhh. Not now, brother. We're being watched. Goodbye.
AuditionLineC:
One night, I heard a voice calling to me from the reactor pit over there. A voice out of the
 shadows. I didn't know what to think at first, but what the voice said sure made a lot of sense. Its
 figures all check out, too. Don't know who or what the voice is, but the facts all tally up just like
 it said.

Name: Hank
VoiceType: Middle-aged-sounding male ghoul
AuditionLineA: Hello, I'm Hank. I take care of the inside of the reactor core. Not that much ever needs to be done there.
AuditionLineB: You talk to Festus about installing that part yet?
AuditionLineC: Well, it hasn't worked too well, lately. It kept overheating. We don't need to use it anyway, so we didn't bother to fix the heat shielding on it. If you can figure out the control codes and don't run it for too long, you may be able to get it to do what you want.

Name: Harold
AuditionLineA: I gotta tell ya, ol' Harold's a bit slow on the draw hisself. The two of us talkin' wouldn't get a whole lot done.
AuditionLineB: Harold, I'd like to know where I can get some healing.
AuditionLineC: Without a functional Hydroelectric Magnetosphere Regulator we're leaking radioactive coolant into the groundwater. Now that means, anyone using that water is not gunna need a night-light to take a midnight piss. Also, we need more fuel because our power plant is not burnin' it very efficiently.

Name: Lenny
AuditionLineA: Hello there, my name's Lenny. H'how can I h'help you?
AuditionLineB: All right, if you think it's really a good idea.
AuditionLineC: Heart pills. I guess what they're p'puttin' out in Vault City and NCR these d'days ain't much different than w'what we were usin' b'back before the w'war. Strong m'medicine. G'get a fella on that stuff, he'd have the h'heart of a m'mutant m'marathon runner. Heck, if he minded his d'doc and took 'em r'regular-like, he could probably live on hot b'buttered chems and n'not have to worry about it skippin' a s'single b'beat. Uh, n'not that I'd recommend that sort o' thing, of course. D'doctors orders are always supposed to be c'clean livin' and p'plenty of r'roughage, right?

Name: Skeeter
VoiceType: Skeeter is a grubby but intelligent ghoul mechanic and gadgeteer. Raspy
AuditionLineA: Just don't touch anything -- you might hurt yourself.
AuditionLineB: Hmm, you don't have enough money to cover the cost of working on that. Got sumthin' else ya want me ta look at?
AuditionLineC: Well, now. You could do that, maybe. Then agin, you might be in fer a little surprise there. I might be tougher than you think. Then again, mebbe you'd jist be slittin' yur own throat. I kin be pretty useful puttin' items together. Always nice to know someone's able to do that, ain't it?

Name: Wooz
AuditionLineA: I am Wooz. What do you want?
AuditionLineB: Nah, maybe some other time Wooz. I got some questions though...
AuditionLineC:
Heh, yeah I heard those assholes are getting attacked by molerats who're protecting those smoothskins. Serves 'em right for fucking with other people's
 business. I don't really know much more than that though. Lumpy over in the junkyard might know more. That smoothskin's always hearing things.

Name: Zomak The Destroyer
AuditionLineA: Renew, comrade! I am Zomak. Some call me Zomak the Destroyer. What is your business here?
AuditionLineB: You have the sign. Go right in.
AuditionLineC: He is the granter of enlightenment. It is he that promises the Renewal to all who follow him.

Name: Chad
VoiceType: Adult male
AuditionLineA: Howdy, friend! What can I do for you?
AuditionLineB: Wrong answer. Looks like you picked the wrong guy to mess with.
AuditionLineC: Oh really?...I thought I recognized you. Oh yeah? Let me help. The documents you're looking for are in a briefcase that's locked away in the bottom drawer of that dresser over there. But you're never gonna touch it, 'cause I'm gonna kill you, you fuckin' do-gooder. If it weren't for you, I coulda kept skimming off the caravan runs for another couple months. But no, you had to go an' meddle in affairs that aren't any of your fuckin' concern. So now I gotta flee town, but at least I'll have the pleasure of leaving your corpse behind.

Name: Dan
AuditionLineA: Who are you? What are you doing in my house?
AuditionLineB: Fine! Fine! Just stop pestering me.
AuditionLineC: She's blonde, sexy, and has the most incredible singing voice... I last saw her walking around this area. She didn't like mutants or ghouls, so she wouldn't have been near any of them. Nobody knows where she went. It's like she just disappeared.

Name: Doc Holliday
AuditionLineA: ::wheeze:: Hi there. I'm Doc Holliday. How can I help you?
AuditionLineB: Just sell me some stimpaks.
AuditionLineC:
Then, I came back here and watched Marcus build the town from the shanties I remember from my
 youth into the "sprawling metropolis" you see before you. I saw people attracted by promises of
 wealth. I saw people grow up and die. I saw the currents of history.

Name: Eric
VoiceType: Eric is a ghoul who attracts flies due to his biology and can't afford enough power to run his AC. He's irritable and exhausted but not unkind. Talking head NPC (Head ID 246). Slightly raspy voice — not cartoonish
AuditionLineA: Like this town needed any more hard luck. Like *I* needed any more.
AuditionLineB: Thanks ever so much for your compassion. That's sarcasm, by the way, in case you hadn't noticed. Get the hell out of my house.
AuditionLineC: I'm Eric. I used to run the hotel in town, but I had to sell it because of my fly problem. I also ran the tavern, but had to get out of that, too, for the same reason. Finally, I used to run the generator, but flies kept getting into it.

Name: Francis
VoiceType: Adult-sounding super mutant — big
AuditionLineA: Help you out with something?
AuditionLineB: Get out of here before my stupid brain decides to beat your face in.
AuditionLineC: If you talked to some of the people in town about your hatred of mutants, you'd find out about the conspiracy. I know two wrongs don't make a right, but I call it self-defense. I did something wrong, and I admit it. I can't stay here. I'll set out to find a way to atone for my actions... That satisfy your sense of justice?

Name: Phil (bartender, arm-wrestle commentary)
VoiceType: A ghoul bartender playing hype-man for the crowd during Francis's arm-wrestling matches. Not a fighter — a heckling
AuditionLineA: Over the top, Francis! Over the top!
AuditionLineB: Lick 'em, Francis! No, not with your tongue!
AuditionLineC: I gotta HAND it to you, friend. You're WRISTing your life trying to beat Francis!

Name: Jacob
AuditionLineA: Hi there. I'm Jacob, the chemist of the Chemist's Drugstore. What can I do for you?
AuditionLineB: You again? Do you want something?
AuditionLineC:
He's been ruling here ever since the Master was destroyed. He puts down anyone who disagrees
 with him... or they just "disappear." The place looks civilized on the top of things, but the truth is
 that it's a killing ground for bloodthirsty mutants. There's a friend of a friend who had friends who
 disappeared after speaking up.

Name: Marcus
AuditionLineA: Well, what the hell. I haven't seen one of those outfits for a long, long time. Takes me back.
AuditionLineB: Humph. Something wasn't right.
AuditionLineC:
Heh. I can use just about any big gun, like rocket launchers or miniguns,
 and the big energy weapons. I ain't bad with my fists, and I'm a hell of a shot with grenades. I don't
 wear armor. They just don't make it my size.

Name: Seymour
AuditionLineA: Hi! Nice weather we've been having, huh?
AuditionLineB: Thanks. I'll try that out. Bye!
AuditionLineC:
Oh, yes, the Professor. He grew me from a tiny spore and nurtured me... but I realized from an early age that if I were to act as smart as I truly
 am, he'd cut me into pieces to examine me. So, I played dumb and got planted out here. It's nice... but I'd like to branch out a little.
 Y'know, maybe get planted someplace else...

Name: Steve
AuditionLineA:
Hi there! I'm Steve. I'm the guy who can tell you where's where and what's what in this fine
 town. Can I direct you someplace, or give you any help today?
AuditionLineB: Tell me about the place.
AuditionLineC:
We're a small mining community. We were founded several decades ago by our sheriff, Marcus, and
 a man named Jacob. The two of them chose this site because it was near some uranium deposits. Would
 you like to hear more?

Name: Typhon
AuditionLineA: Howdy there, kiddo, and welcome to the Old Ghouls' Home!
AuditionLineB: 'Ere! [Give Cat's Paw to Typhon.]
AuditionLineC:
All right. I remember stashing the cash somewhere downtown. It's been so many years, though, and the buildings have been
 built and rebuilt over and over, that I'm not sure exactly where it is. If it helps any, I remember thinkin' I should put it
 somewhere that wasn't likely to be torn down or plowed over. Somewhere indispensable, ya' know? Good luck to you.

Name: Zaius
VoiceType: Zaius is a super mutant (older-generation; tough
AuditionLineA: You the new guy in town?
AuditionLineB: Thanks for selling the ore. It's not like we couldn't use it or anything. So...
AuditionLineC: Well, as the mutants are not only getting old and senile -- the gas keeps them young, or something -- I'd have to say things are pretty good. I mean, we don't want to kill everyone, and as far as I can tell, the humans don't think too poorly of us. 'Course, that's not including the humans from the other places around here... Now those are some bastards.

Name: Aldo
VoiceType: Middle-aged man
AuditionLineA: Hello there, I haven't seen you in Klamath before. I'm Aldo, the town greeter. (hic) It's my job to greet anyone new in town and to answer any questions they might have about our bucolic little burg. Welcome to Klamath. (hic) Who might you be?
AuditionLineB: Well stranger, since you're (hic) new to these parts, you probably don't (urp) know that it's (hic) customary to tip the town greeter before asking any questions and such.
AuditionLineC: You can buy or trade things at Buckner House and also the Golden Gecko. Sometimes they even have healing herbs available -- not that they'd give me any for my (hic) condition. They're both run by real skinflints. Just get a little behind on your (hic) tab and out you go, into the cold and rain.

Name: Ardin Buckner
VoiceType: Ardin is a sturdy
AuditionLineA: I hear you hurt my boy Torr. I don't know exactly what happened, but I don't want you anywhere near here. Now get out.
AuditionLineB: Have you found my son, Torr, or my friend, Smiley the trapper, yet?
AuditionLineC: I thought they were up to their usual tricks! My poor little Torr, what bullies those boys were. Well, that explains what's been spooking Torr, but I wish there was more proof that it was the Duntons. I'm afraid word of mouth just isn't good enough. And now that the Duntons are dead, I'm not sure if we'll ever get to the bottom of this. But if you come up with anything else, please let me know.

Name: Chuck or Buck Dunton
VoiceType: Two adult male identical twins
AuditionLineA: You just better push off, or my brother and I are going to pound your little head into jam.
AuditionLineB: After a long day in the brahmin pen, we get some choice boot scrapings to flavor it with.
AuditionLineC: Here's what's happening. You need to get Torr out of here for a while. You can talk to him or knock him unconscious. But don't kill him or you'll get people all riled up. While you do that, we'll get the brahmin. Meet us back at our shop tomorrow to pick up your reward.

Name: Jenny
VoiceType: Attractive but tired. Professional but friendly. She deals with rough trappers and wastelanders daily. Demeanor ranges from gently patronizing (low intelligence/low performance) to openly flirtatious (high endurance/high charisma)
AuditionLineA: Gee, mister, that was pretty quick. You must be pretty new at this sort of thing. Just relax a bit and you'll enjoy it more.
AuditionLineB: Vault-Tec? He might have had something like that. I'm not sure. I know he did have a lot of really old stuff.
AuditionLineC: I don't rightly know where Vic is. I know he has a house just down the street from us, to the east. He could be out trading with tribals or even in the Den, for all I know. I hope he's okay. He was getting to be more than just a steady customer to me.

Name: Maida Buckner
VoiceType: A tough
AuditionLineA: You've really made me angry. I don't want anything further to do with you. Now just get out. Tribals, humph! (mutter, mutter) ...shiftless, worthless, lazy...
AuditionLineB: You want to barter? I'm always looking for good quality gecko pelts, and I pay a fair price for them, too.
AuditionLineC: Well, there's a canyon just east of where we graze the brahmin. Torr used to come up with wild stories about bugmen coming from there. He said that it was bugmen that mutilated our brahmin. Scared himself silly with those fool stories.

Name: Sajag
VoiceType: A short
AuditionLineA: Hello there, stranger. Welcome to the Golden Gecko Tavern, Hotel, and Trading Post. I'm Sajag; I run the place. What can I get for you?
AuditionLineB: Just like one of your kind to try and get something for nothing. No money, no service; now get out.
AuditionLineC: Some say that there's a gigantic rat, the size of a Corvega, that rules over all the rats over in Trapper Town, west of here. They say that it lives in an old mine underneath Trapper Town and that all the other rats bring it any shiny objects that they find. (licks his lips) Mmm, shiny baubles.

Name: Sally Dunton
VoiceType: Older adult female
AuditionLineA: Hello there, my name's Sally Dunton. Hmm, did you catch that?
AuditionLineB: I know you're a tribal and all, but this is a bathhouse, not an outhouse. Git out afore I have you thrown out!
AuditionLineC: Hmm, I don't know if Jenny will even take you in the condition that you're in. You're going to need a thorough, no-nonsense, scrubbing first. (To herself: I wonder if Gerda is free for that?) With the cost of the pre-scrubbing, the Round-the-World Full Squeaky Clean Servicing is yours for only $185.

Name: Slim Picket
AuditionLineA:
Well, mister, you sure don't look chewed up by those rats yet -- but you will if you keep
 pestering them. Just don't bring any back here with you.
AuditionLineB: You're interested in trapping, huh? (He looks you up and down.)
AuditionLineC:
Well, they taste pretty good if you spit-roast 'em with just a pinch of herbs. But most of the
 time they can be a real nuisance, and they're getting worse. We've barricaded the north part of the
 mall -- well, Trapper Town, that is -- but they're sneaking through anyway. There's one door right here
 behind my room, but I have it locked.

Name: Smiley
AuditionLineA:
Hello there, stranger. People call me Smiley. I'm sure glad to see you. I thought I was going
 to die here for certain! I'm hurt too bad to get past those damn lizards on my own.
AuditionLineB: Well, I had a few questions about hunting geckos.
AuditionLineC:
Well, I guess they don't like to crawl through the goo too much. I can't say as I blame them.
 It sure burns if gets on your skin. But that doesn't seem to stop 'em from licking up the darn stuff
 like it was Buckner's Best.

Name: Sulik
AuditionLineB: Hey, I can only hear you talking so far.
AuditionLineC:
Slavers got our sis. Thought Vic be having information. Couldn't peep him, got p.o.'d, drank
 like a fish. Spirits of Anger and Chaos pop out and now we have to pay some coin to make it right.

Name: Torr Buckner
VoiceType: Torr is a large
AuditionLineA: You bad. You hurt Torr. Go away now!
AuditionLineB: Torr see bugmen hurt moo-moo.
AuditionLineC: Ook! Ugmen, Ulik ribal, Smiley mook. (Well, there's my bugmen problem. Then there's Sulik, the tribal, that my mom is making work off a debt — I think sis is in love with him. Mom's boyfriend, a fellow named Smiley, is missing someplace out to the west. Quite exciting here, lately.)

Name: Balthas
AuditionLineA: My son was mistakenly killed in the fight.
AuditionLineB: . Now that we're properly introduced, you seem troubled.
AuditionLineC:
Does that mean you'll help me? Thank you! Jonny was last seen playing cowboys and Indians with
 his dog Laddie out front. The two of them are inseparable; in fact, that's how we knew something was
 wrong. One day, Laddie came back without Jonny. We've been searching ever since. Take Laddie with
 you; maybe the two of you will be able to find Jonny.

Name: Cornelius
AuditionLineA:
Other than the slightly unsettled look on his face, there appears to be nothing out of the
 ordinary about him.
AuditionLineB: I have a watch. It was a gold watch. I wonder where I put it?
AuditionLineC:
A while back, I forget when... my best friend of 30... or was it 40 years? Oh, it doesn't matter,
 what matters is that he stole my precious gold pocket watch. It has been handed down in my family for
 five, no six, err... four generations. Yep, I distinctly remember setting it down on my desk. Then,
 when I looked on the kitchen table, it was gone.

Name: Davin
VoiceType: Davin is a young man in his twenties
AuditionLineA: If you asked, you could have me.
AuditionLineB: OK, I'm right behind you all the way.
AuditionLineC: I used to skin the brahmin at the slaughterhouse, so I'm pretty handy with the knife. Also dad had me beat a brahmin to death with a crowbar once. I guess I could use a club if I need to. Uhhh, oh yeah, dad took me to shoot a pistol once, but I got scared and almost shot him by accident.

Name: Farrel
AuditionLineA: You hear the sound of dry twigs cracking every time he moves.
AuditionLineB: Then get out, you dimwitted cave dweller!
AuditionLineC:
Would you really? Nobody will help me because they think I stole the watch. It would be nice to
 have somebody on my side, for once. I've already questioned everyone about it, but it won't hurt to ask
 everybody again. Maybe they'll tell you something they wouldn't tell me. It also won't hurt to poke yer
 nose around Rose's Bed and Breakfast; Cornelius is notorious for putting stuff down and forgetting
 where he put it a minute later.

Name: Grisham
AuditionLineA: You can't quite place him, but he looks familiar.
AuditionLineB: was different, but there's only one way to make this right!
AuditionLineC:
Actually, it has kind of helped my business. Nobody has been able to grow sufficient
 food for their brahmin, so they are severely culling their herds. But that's just a temporary thing;
 you have to look at the big picture. With the decline in the brahmin population, my business can only
 suffer.

Name: Jo
VoiceType: Middle-aged frontier everyman
AuditionLineA: Thank you for saving the residents of Modoc.
AuditionLineB: You've got to be joking! I'm not going to cut my finger off. I'm desperate, not stupid! Now, do you want the job or not?
AuditionLineC: [Acting a little embarrassed.] Um... well, you see, I don't really know anything about this holy GECK thing you're looking for. You have to understand; we were desperate! However, I do know of a place called Gecko. It's a ways east of here somewhere. If I were a betting man, I would wager your GECK gizmo is located there. I wish I had more I could give you, but we're still a poor community with not much in the way of offerings. The best I can do is offer you goods at basically my cost. But I'd be honored to help keep you stocked for your journeys when I have the goods and I'm sure any of the other residents would be equally grateful if you asked them. Thank you! You've saved us all.

Name: Jonny
AuditionLineA: Blonde hair, blue eyes; your typical all-American looking kid.
AuditionLineB: Please hurry. I want to go home.
AuditionLineC:
That's right! Yipee! I'm going home. Ask Vegeir if it's all right for you to take me home. He's
 been so nice to me, I don't want to leave until he says it's all right. Please hurry; I'm homesick.

Name: Laddie
VoiceType: A border collie — alert
AuditionLineA: Woof!
AuditionLineB: Woof! Woof! Woof!
AuditionLineC: Woof! Woof! Woof! [Laddie jumps on you and starts to lick your face.]

Name: Miria
AuditionLineA: Oh my! A very shapely and seductive looking woman.
AuditionLineB: [Your world will never be the same again.]
AuditionLineC:
Ah, Rose. The proprietor of Rose's Bed and Breakfast. Now, you didn't hear it from
 me, but have you ever wondered why her 'coop' is so well protected? She says it's to
 protect her chickens from predators, but if you look closely it looks as if she's
 trying to keep something in rather than out. Plus, whoever heard of chickens laying twelve pound
 eggs?

Name: Rose
AuditionLineA:
Her gray hair is done up in a loose bun, and she walks with a slight waddle. You can't help but
 feel relaxed around her.
AuditionLineB: You must hear things working here. Mind if I ask you a few questions?
AuditionLineC:
Oh dear! Have you been talking to my husband Cornelius? This whole business with the watch is
 just terrible. Cornelius has got the whole town believing that his best friend, Farrel, took his watch.
 If you've talked to him, I'm sure you've noticed his mind isn't quite functioning properly. I'm pretty
 sure the poor dear just left the watch somewhere and forgot where.

Name: Vegeir
AuditionLineA: A tall, stately man. His movements remind you of a cat stalking its prey.
AuditionLineB: Enough! No more questions. Make your decision now!
AuditionLineC: Years ago, someone tried to take over our farm, harvesting crops and stealing animals they had no right to. We are not a violent people by nature, but something had to be done. Our survival at the time depended on those crops. That's when we came up with the ghost idea. Smearing ourselves with glowing fungus, we were able to scare away this person and any other nosy neighbors. Unfortunately, this has been a little too effective. Lately, we've been seeking to make contact with the surfacers, but no one comes to the farm anymore for fear of the ghosts. Luckily, you dropped by.

Name: Angela Bishop
AuditionLineA: My father's gonna KILL you when he hears how you treated me.
AuditionLineB: Looks like one of Daddy's new whores...
AuditionLineC:
You say one word to good ol' Dad, and you'll find yourself 'flying' off the top of the highest building in New Reno.
 Once they find the little note I leave, everybody'll call it a suicide. It'll be a TERRIBLE tragedy. They'll be crying in the aisles.

Name: Big Jesus Mordino
VoiceType: Big Jesus Mordino is a morbidly obese crime boss dying slowly from a serious heart condition. He sweats constantly
AuditionLineA: Stay away from there.
AuditionLineB: (Nods.) Very well. Here is... your payment. A hundred... chips. For a... simple delivery... It is more than enough.
AuditionLineC: (Mordino studies you.) Very well. I... have work for you. Take... (Takes a deep wheezing breath, wipes sweat from his forehead.) ...this package... to the *stables* north of Reno. Give it to a man... Ramirez, then return.

Name: John Bishop
AuditionLineA: You got some balls coming in here.
AuditionLineB: Tribal, my patience is wearing thin. Did you kill Carlson or not?
AuditionLineC:
A thousand or nothing. This is a special job, and I got expenses. I got to get to NCR, arrange the 'accident,'
 and most likely have to shell out some MORE cash for some special 'accident-prone' items to get things done. So
 don't push ME, all right?

Name: Christopher Wright
VoiceType: Young
AuditionLineA: Hey! Way to kick the Enclave's ass!
AuditionLineB: Hey! How's it going? Everybody treating you all right? Anything you need?
AuditionLineC: Well, I... I mean, the Wright family... My family... Might have an opening. I ain't promising nothing, but go to the mansion south of here, find my brother Keith and tell him I sent you. Name's Chris. Chris Wright.

Name: Eldridge
AuditionLineA: Congratulations, hero! You done good!
AuditionLineB: Shooooo-eeee. ::Rubs eyes:: That Power Armor?!
AuditionLineC:
(Blinks in surprise, then laughs.) Haw! No, no... those weapons are something else, ain't they? Sure would LIKE
 to get my hands on one, though... check out the range, power, fire rate...(Stares into distance, sighs.)

Name: Ethyl Wright
AuditionLineA: *Sigh*
AuditionLineB: Okay. No arguments here. So what does the Union do?
AuditionLineC:
Here you go. Everything in this locker is yours. Some money to help you in your travels... and
 a handy tool that I have found useful in pounding sense into the particularly mule-headed. Thank you for all
 you've done.

Name: Father Tully
AuditionLineA: I am thoroughblest.
AuditionLineB: Sinfulness! Wickedness! Eh... what are you doing later?
AuditionLineC:
Well dat wuz a loooong time ago. I haddent quite gotten my act together yet. It waz before th' angel Mrs Wright put me in line. Ya see,
 them monks didn't take kindly to my wild ways. Me and Brother Samuel, we useta get a lil crazy. Hehe, this one night, Sammy and I went 'round to
 the sleepin monks, and put their handz in bowls a warm water. Even got the Abbot! Ha! Those were the dayz, lemme tell ya.
THATLink: Closed on CCC as "cast offsite" — no username published

Name: Jagged Jimmy J
AuditionLineA: Hey, if it ain't
AuditionLineB: You looking to get high? Jagged Jimmy's your man.
AuditionLineC:
Wha...? Well, Jules can kiss my natural black ass, and it'd be the only ass in town he AIN'T kissed yet. He don't know SHIT. He don't
 even have the balls to talk shit to my face. YOU decide who's telling the truth.

Name: Jules
AuditionLineA: Let Jules show you 'round, slaver.
AuditionLineB: Mutants from the wastes? Wasn't that eighty years ago?
AuditionLineC:
By 'laser pistols,' Jules, I mean pistols that emit beams of coherent light. A beam of sufficient wattage - say, several
 megawatts - could do considerable damage if focused on a target for a few seconds, producing the effect you've described.

Name: Keith Wright
VoiceType: A thin
AuditionLineA: Who are you?
AuditionLineB: Get outta here, dimbulb. Next time you talk to me, I'll plug you fulla holes.
AuditionLineC: Quiet kid, clean kid. Kept outta trouble, and for a Wright, that's something. We buried him on the Golgotha plains a while ago, but even so, Mom still don't want his room disturbed. It's hard for her to let go, y'know?

Name: Miss Kitty
AuditionLineA: First quarter revenues are up slightly... now, if we account for the increased tribute...
AuditionLineB: Why, if it isn't Reno's most famous prizefighter!
AuditionLineC:
(As you speak, she looks up, startled.) You! You came back! I... I thought you might be dead. (She looks
 relieved.) I was so *worried.* Risking your life, taking on the Enclave... that's the bravest thing I've ever heard.

Name: Leslie Anne Bishop
AuditionLineA:
(The woman turns to face you. She is quite attractive, with a low cut dress made out of Gold Gecko
 skin. She studies you for a moment, then frowns.) Yes, what is it?
AuditionLineB: Very well, thanks for your time. I appreciate it.
AuditionLineC:
(Your question is met with silence... Mrs. Bishop has fallen asleep. You can't
 help but wonder if she would've stayed awake longer if you'd been more... skilled,
 but you quickly repress the thought before it hurts your ego.)

Name: Lil' Jesus Mordino
AuditionLineA: Yo!
AuditionLineB: ::Starts playing with his knife threateningly.::
AuditionLineC:
There's Jules, front of town, peddles mostly to newcomers... n' Jagged Jimmy J, up on 2nd street by the gym... can't
 miss that punk-ass cause he cut his face up one night while on Jet... it's so bad his entire face is all scars.
THATLink: Closed on CCC as "cast offsite" — no username published

Name: Mason
AuditionLineA: What're you doing up here?
AuditionLineB: You done walking in the wrong place, tribal. Get.
AuditionLineC:
About a thousand chips. Now look, that ain't nothin' to Mr. Salvatore, but he's got this policy
 with regards to people who take ANYTHING from him. If I were you, I'd remember that. Mr. Salvatore's gonna want EVERY chip
 back.

Name: Darlin' Nikki
AuditionLineA: ::Cheers::
AuditionLineB: Hey, champ...(smiles)...wanna take a chance?
AuditionLineC:
Nikki, if you don't tell me everything right now, I'll tell Mr. Salvatore you were in on it, whether you were or not.
 He'll have Mason cut you up seven ways to Sunday, and have your job filled in an hour.

Name: Orville Wright
AuditionLineA: Get away from there!
AuditionLineB: Yeah, it was Jules, the dealer at the front of town.
AuditionLineC:
Way I see it, the Mordinos control the Jet in Reno. Naturally, you'd blame them for a drug overdose... and then there'd
 be war. IF you two didn't wipe each other out, you'd at least be weakened by the fight. That makes life easier for the
 Salvatores... all they have to worry about then is the Bishops.

Name: Renesco
AuditionLineA: One more lens, that's all I ask.
AuditionLineB: All except one: Was Richard Wright one of your customers?
AuditionLineC: (Renesco gazes around wide-eyed at the rest of the shop's chemically stupefied patrons before leaning in and rounding on you in a lowered voice, sibilant with rage) You. IGNORANT. Toad-licking, tumleweed worshipping ass. I don't think *Mr Bishop* would be very happy AT ALL if he were to hear that one of the talking brahmin turds on his payroll had been dropping his name while purchasing HIGHLY SPECIALIZED MURDER WEAPONS.

Name: Marjorie Reed
AuditionLineA: Hello, Myron.
AuditionLineB: Test results from Jet Beta are very promising, but...
AuditionLineC:
It's potent *enough,* but there's room for improvement. The 'brass' wants to increase Jet distribution in
 Redding, and they want the addiction rate as close to 100% as we can get it. It's going to require us pulling some long hours.

Name: Louis Salvatore
AuditionLineA: *Cough*
AuditionLineB: Uh, okay. Well then, I'm looking for a job.
AuditionLineC:
(Takes a deep breath from the oxygen mask.) There is... a man... who
 has used his... skill with cards to rob me. The sum is... trivial. The insult is not. I want him killed and
 the money he stole returned.

Name: Stuart Little
AuditionLineA: Kid, I knew you'd do good, but I didn't know you were gonna save the world, too. Good job.
AuditionLineB: Glad I took the chance on you, sweetheart.
AuditionLineC:
(Looks at you pityingly.) But do you see the TRAGEDY here? I have mistakenly reduced you to a stereotype, a caricature,
 a generic Fallout model, instead of regarding you as a specific, unique character.

Name: T-Ray
AuditionLineA: You can barely make out T-Ray past all that attitude.
AuditionLineB: Where did you get that Highwayman? I like the look of it.
AuditionLineC:
As I see it, this Highwayman... most likely the last of its kind in working order... is worth at LEAST 3000 chips... but
 y'know what? (Winks) I'm willing to part with this fine machine for 2700 chips considerin' the condition. A-course, we'd
 need ta talk about FRINGE benefits: club privileges, free admission to the ho-house...

Name: Myron
AuditionLineA: Get off your asses and get in here, guys! We got an intruder!
AuditionLineB: Owwww. Wish SOMEONE would patch these wounds.
AuditionLineC: Well... maybe it would work, but I'm pretty sure Jet would just chew right through that shit. Now wh-wh-why the hell are we even talking about this?! Wh-where would you get your hands on endorphin blockers anyway?

Name: Ariel
AuditionLineA: Hello, I'm Ariel. I don't think I've seen you here before. Who are you?
AuditionLineB: Tough break. I'll be seeing ya.
AuditionLineC:
I was holding Sandy behind me, trying to keep her from the monster that had shot Rand. He stood
 next to my husband's body and laughed at me as he aimed his gun at my head. Suddenly, this huge claw
 came out of the darkness, grabbed him from behind and... well, thank goodness that Sandy didn't see
 what happened next. Anyway, the raiders were being wiped out by this group of deathclaws. The one that
 saved Sandy and me stood near us and talked to me. He kept reassuring me that I was safe, and that he
 was sorry that he couldn't have gotten there sooner to help us. Afterwards, the deathclaws brought us
 here.

Name: Dalia
AuditionLineA: Well, I'll be. How are you doing,
AuditionLineB: What do you want to know?
AuditionLineC:
So, I sneak up on this camp site and there are these two deathclaws sitting around the fire just
 chatting away. Idiot that I am, I let out a little cry of surprise, jumped up, and turned to run -- right
 into the arms of another deathclaw standing right behind me. Anyway, to make a long story short, it
 took awhile for me to realize that I wasn't about to be put on a spit and barbecued. Instead, I was
 brought here and 'interviewed' by Gruthar. Now I can live here if I want.

Name: Goris
AuditionLineA: Hello, I'm Goris. I don't recognize you; are you new here?
AuditionLineB: I understand. Perhaps you'll reconsider later.
AuditionLineC: These aren't your average deathclaws, as I'm sure you noticed. They've had their intelligence enhanced by some means not understood by them. It was done by a group of humans known as 'The Enclave.' It seems this Enclave needed an army and they chose deathclaws because of their ferocity, physical prowess, and... well, you get the picture. Anyway, the only thing lacking in deathclaws was their intelligence. They needed to be smart enough to understand complex commands, but not so smart that they'd be a threat to 'those in charge.'

Name: Gruthar
VoiceType: Gruthar is unmistakably a deathclaw — a huge
AuditionLineA: You tell your so-called President that he will burn for this.
AuditionLineB: Do not fear me, human. I do not intend to harm you. I am Gruthar, leader of this deathclaw pack. Why have you come here?
AuditionLineC: There are many machines here, machines built by humans. Deathclaw hands cannot use these machines. However, there is one machine that understands questions. I ask it to run the other machines and it obeys. This machine no longer listens. It will no longer run the other machines. We are running out of food and water. I have ordered raids on the human lands so that we may survive. I am not proud of this and I would put an end to it. If you repair this machine, I will be able to feed my people once again. I will gladly stop the raids. Will you agree to this?

Name: Joseph
AuditionLineA: Hello, I'm Joseph the herbalist. What can I help you with?
AuditionLineB: I feel ill. Can you help me?
AuditionLineC:
Although they do not have vocal chords, the deathclaws seem to mimic human speech much the same
 as a parrot does. I have yet to discover the exact mechanism behind this, so I am unable to say more at
 this time. Socially, they are pack animals with a very rigid code of ethics. They are led by an 'alpha
 male' who rules with the mutual consent of the pack. They appear to be extremely loyal to the pack as a
 whole, treating it as a family unit rather than having individual families as humans do.

Name: Vice President Bird
AuditionLineA: Here are some of our gallant troopers. What are you doing in the Vice-President's office?
AuditionLineB: Aren't we already in the... Uh, to go *where*?
AuditionLineC: I think that maybe Mars would be nice because Mars is essentially in the same orbit... Mars is somewhat the same distance from the Sun, which is very important. We have seen pictures where there are canals, we believe, and water. If there is water, that means there is oxygen. If oxygen, that means we can breathe.

Name: Charles Curling
AuditionLineA: What are you doing out?
AuditionLineB: You fucking bigot. You need to be put away, right now.
AuditionLineC: There are a number of, primarily, very subtle changes. I haven't had time to look into the ramifications of the changes yet though. Also, I'd have to backtrack to isolate your initial gene-stock before I could hazard any ideas on the direction the changes are taking. All in all though, the information is clear enough.

Name: Frank Horrigan
AuditionLineA: You're not getting out of here alive, mutie.
AuditionLineB: You're going to pay for what you've done.
AuditionLineC: You (cough), you haven't won here. You and your mutie-bastard friends are gonna join me in a big ol' mushroom cloud sendoff. I just triggered the self-destruct. (Heh, heh; cough, cough...) The work will go on. You didn't do nothing here, 'cept seal your own death warrants. Duty, (cough) honor... courage... Semper Fiiiii...

Name: Sergeant Granite
AuditionLineA: Let's get that lunatic.
AuditionLineB: Oh, I see. What do you mean *usually?*
AuditionLineC: Don't you tell a pretty story. You make me laugh. Y'know, I think you might even last over the one-minute mark with Horrigan. That'd be a new record. Good luck, mutie.

Name: Dick Richardson
AuditionLineA: You there, what are you doing outside of the reconditioning center?
AuditionLineB: How do you intend to do that? What are you doing here?
AuditionLineC: As the embodiment of the executive branch, I bear the burden of ensuring the survival and prosperity of the United States and of humanity itself. A heavy burden and yet if it means the return of the earth to our children and to their children, I bear it gladly.

Name: Mayor Ascorti
AuditionLineA: Keep on movin', pal.
AuditionLineB: Not a problem. Let me ask you about something else, though.
AuditionLineC:
Well, there are some dang critters in there that need to be killed before anyone will work the
 mine. If'n you were to buy the deed - and then kill off the critters infesting it - I'd be happy to buy
 the deed back off you for a nice profit.

Name: Painless Doc Johnson
VoiceType: Redding's only doctor — thin
AuditionLineA: Your head is larger than I would think.
AuditionLineB: Got yourself all scraped up, huh? Well, let Doc Johnson take a look at that. Easy now, I'm a professional.
AuditionLineC: You need to have the Dermal Impact Armor installed before I can give you the Assault Enhancement. But I'll tell you what it should do. The Assault Enhancement should give you a total of 10% resistance to normal and explosive damage - over and above any other armor you're wearing. The operation takes a few days and it'll cost you $30,000. In addition, you're not going to be too Charismatic after I finish. Cramming all those impact plates under your skin is going to make you look pretty damn angular, but in a very streamlined way. But who doesn't like the way a new car looks - I'll try not to give you tail-fins.

Name: Fannie Mae
VoiceType: Fannie Mae is a saloon girl in Redding
AuditionLineA: [Fannie looks distinctly unhealthy as she wobbles towards you] Hey there, lover. I'm feeling a little under the weather lately. Want to give me some money for a quick boost? I can make it worth your while. (grins)
AuditionLineB: Maybe you'll last a bit longer this time, honey. You'll get more of your $60 worth that way.
AuditionLineC: [Fannie looks like a great weight has been lifted from her shoulders] Hey, it's you! Lou told me what you did. That stuff she slipped me sure made me sick, but I haven't felt a need fer Jet since then. (She kisses you on the cheek) I don't know how I can ever thank you... well, I do know *one* way. Whenever you're in the mood, just come on by; free of charge. (wink)

Name: Obidiah Hakeswill
AuditionLineA: Here now. What do you think you're doing?
AuditionLineB: Damn whores; they're all the same. Where's my razor?
AuditionLineC:
Taking me to jail? I'll come peaceably. No sense in making more trouble. The bitch still got
 what she deserved. You can't kill me. I'm invincible, but you can sure piss off the other miners. Got
 eyes in the back of your head, do you?

Name: Louise
VoiceType: Lou is the owner and madam of the Malamute Saloon in Redding — a frontier brothel and drinking establishment. She's a tough
AuditionLineA: I just want you to know that I'm thankful for what you did. How can I help you?
AuditionLineB: Well, I hear all kinds of things about the whole city bein' full o' nuthin' but crazy followers of some kind of kooky religion.
AuditionLineC: In the north part of town Dan McGrew runs the Morningstar mine. Usually the miners get paid on account or with chits from each mine... You know, scrip. Well, my girl was found with one of those pieces of scrip in her hand. Here it is. Look for yourself. (She hands you the scrip.)

Name: Marge LeBarge
AuditionLineA: Sorry, I don't have time for charity cases right now.
AuditionLineB: I'd love to listen but I've got to be going. Goodbye.
AuditionLineC:
Well, people always talk about Vault City taking over to get our gold. Or one of the families in
 New Reno getting everyone hooked on their dope in order to take over. Or even the NCR wanting to annex
 us. I tell you, the NCR's our best bet - but they're all just out for our gold. Redding's still
 independent, so far.

Name: Earl Marion
AuditionLineA: You're about a taco short of a combination plate.
AuditionLineB: Interesting. Let me ask you something else, Sheriff Marion.
AuditionLineC:
Didn't I? Must have plum darn slipped my mind. Yup, that's what it did. Well, he's got three
 older brothers... even meaner than he was, from what I hear. Let's see... Toad, Newt and Snake Morton, if
 I remember aright. Heck, you know how tall tales can get. By the way, keep that badge I gave you. You
 earned it... Sheriff. (He smiles.)

Name: Dan McGrew
AuditionLineA: If you had a brain, I think it'd just up and die of loneliness.
AuditionLineB: Just keep an eye on your own miners too from now on. Goodbye.
AuditionLineC:
Vault City? (he laughs) Those bigots would turn Redding into a slave-labor camp. They don't see
 anyone who's not one of their precious Citizens as being worth a warm bucket of spit. Spending my life
 bowing and scraping to those bigots isn't my idea of any kind of life.

Name: Ben Wade
AuditionLineA: You've got nerve coming 'round here for a job. You'll never work for me again.
AuditionLineB: You cheap bastard! You'll pay for stiffing me. Goodbye.
AuditionLineC:
Hello there. My name's Ben. Ben Wade. I'm in charge of trade caravans between Redding and Vault
 City. I can usually use an extra guard or two. We leave town on the 1st of every month. If you want to
 sign on, make sure you're here then.

Name: Doctor Jubilee
AuditionLineA: It's Doc Jubilee.
AuditionLineB: You think you're dealing with some shifty bartertown sawbones,
AuditionLineC: Let's see... for starters, you should prob'ly stop doing... well, near to just about everything oughta cover it. No drinking, no smoking, no red meat, NO chems. Try to get a half-hour a day of MILD exercise. And take it easy. Life ain't a race, 'least not the kind where you want to be first to finish. Truth told, no one ever listens to this stuff, but at least I'll be able to rest easier tonight.

Name: Ranger Chief Elise
AuditionLineA: It's Elise.
AuditionLineB: So, changed your mind? Ready to prove your worth?
AuditionLineC: Well-met, fellow Ranger. Afraid there's not much for you to do around here at this time. Most our people are already out on patrol. I'll spread the word that you're one of us now. I wouldn't want you getting shot by one of us.

Name: Enlightened One
AuditionLineA: It's the Enlightened One.
AuditionLineB: Wonderful, brother. So what level are you?
AuditionLineC: I tell you, spreading the word of Hubology out here is harder than you can imagine! AHS-9 just doesn't understand the difficulty. In fact, I've written it all down. Say, would you be willing to deliver it to AHS-9 in San Francisco? I can't promise any reward, but I know AHS-9 will appreciate it.

Name: Doctor Henry
AuditionLineA: It's Dr. Henry.
AuditionLineB: You are out of your mind. Just completely loony.
AuditionLineC: You'll be participating in an important experiment, in fact, the most important, scientific-oh, you mean money. Well, I do have a Cyber-Hound Mk. II, Personal Security Model that I brought with me. I suppose I could have it activated and on-line by the time you got back. Would that do?

Name: Merk
AuditionLineA: It's Merk - folks call him The Man around here.
AuditionLineB: Cute. You gonna answer my question or not?
AuditionLineC: Looks like we can do business, friend. Here's the deal - there's a loopy scientist in town - Dr. Henry. He's got some papers I'd like. I'll pay $1000 for them. Oh, and I don't want no harm to come to Dr Henry. He's useful alive. Interested?

Name: Mira
AuditionLineA: You'd guess that even with the green hair and the scowl, she's the bartender of this joint.
AuditionLineB: What's the deal on this Merk guy?
AuditionLineC: You did what? Oh, if I wasn't on duty, I'd climb over this bar and... well, kiss you. The little prick deserved it. In fact, don't tell anyone but I was hoping to get some stupid ox to do the job for me. Had a little reward all set aside. It's yours now - as far as I'm concerned you earned it.

Name: Robodog
VoiceType: Robodog is a half-dog
AuditionLineA: Arf-arf-arf-arf-arf-arf-arf!
AuditionLineB: Rowf? <boing> Raggy?
AuditionLineC: <whirrr> Not bird, nor plane, nor even frog, just lil' old me - Robodog!<click>

Name: Sheriff Dumont
AuditionLineA: It's the sheriff of NCR.
AuditionLineB: Vault 15? Squatters? What's going on?
AuditionLineC: Desert rats. You got to understand -- this town traces its roots back to 15. Seems there was some trouble there a long time ago and the survivors founded Shady Sands. So by right, Vault 15 is our property. Few years back some squatters moved in and there's been trouble ever since. You should talk to Tandi about it.

Name: Vortis
VoiceType: Vortis is a scrawny
AuditionLineA: So what do you want?
AuditionLineB: Yeah, I may have some feelings about the Rangers. You looking for work?
AuditionLineC: Well then, you should know some folks see them as a potential problem. It would be extremely useful if we had a map of their safe houses through the north - New Reno, Klamath, wherever. I'd be willing to pay, oh say, $500 for something like that. You think you could get that for me?

Name: Roger Westin
AuditionLineA: It's Councilor Westin.
AuditionLineB: Bye-bye and sleep tight, old man.
AuditionLineC: I'm not sure I believe you, but here's your pay. Hell, if you been lying, my boys will find you. I also said I'd give you some information, so here it is. I've heard a lot of stories about Tandi and the Vault Dweller. Seems he saved her life years ago before NCR was even founded. Anyway, legend has it that he spent a lot of time exploring a vault east of here. If that isn't Vault 13 then maybe you'll find a clue there that will lead you to it.

Name: Tandi
AuditionLineA: I'm Tandi, president of NCR. My boys tell me you're looking for work. What are you handy at?
AuditionLineB: What can you tell me about Vault 15?
AuditionLineC: Congressman Westin? One of the biggest brahmin ranchers around. His spreads on the west side of town. Just don't bring up New Reno if you talk to him - it gets him going. If you're looking for a steady job... but you aren't that type, are you?

Name: Don
VoiceType: Don runs the Slaver Camp on Metzger's behalf and is exactly as pleasant as that job implies — foul-mouthed
AuditionLineA: Hey, what the fuck!? Who the hell are you?
AuditionLineB: I'm busy. Go see Metzger in the Den if you want to do a run.
AuditionLineC: [Sweat begins to form on the man's tattooed head.] Whoa, hold on a second. I never said I couldn't spare a few. In fact, here, take the key to the shack, that's where we keep our, uh, personal favorites. The pick of the litter, you might say. [He hands you a key and smiles nervously.]

Name: Krom
VoiceType: Krom is a towering
AuditionLineA: [This sun bronzed giant looks as if his corded muscles were carved out of granite. Beneath a mane of black hair, his smoldering blue eyes pierce into you.] I'm Krom, the head warrior of this tribe. Who are you, and what brings you here?
AuditionLineB: [Several hours pass by in a haze of sweaty, brutal passion. Finally, you lay on the floor of Krom's hut, exhausted. Krom lies at your side, his eyes devouring the contours of your body.] By the Gods, girl, you're incredible!
AuditionLineC: [He dismissively shrugs his mighty shoulders.] Just another of the Old One's lazy scientific baubles, meant to replace the tried and true method of Man toiling against the unforgiving Earth -- forging his own existence though sweat and blood. But if you truly believe such a device is your only hope, then I suggest you seek out the Old One's underground Vaults. I've traveled far and wide, but I've never found one myself. But then, I wasn't exactly looking.

Name: Chieftain
VoiceType: An ancient tribal elder — small
AuditionLineA: [The old man smokes his pipe and watches you with dull gray eyes that seem to bore into your soul. He motions for you to sit across from him in the smoke-filled tent.] Thank you for bringing Kurisu back to our village. [He takes a long hit off his pipe.] The spirits... they have much to say about you. Much indeed. Tell me, is there something you need?
AuditionLineB: The Holy GECK... [He takes a long hit off his pipe.] There is a creature that we sometimes hunt -- sometimes, it hunts us. A gecko. No, I sense that's not what you seek. I'm afraid your Holy GECK is beyond my ken.
AuditionLineC: [The old man smokes his pipe and watches you with dull grey eyes that seem to bore into your soul. He motions for you to sit across from him in the smoke-filled tent.] You have done a great deed, child. I hear the cries of many wicked bonespirits lost out in the Great Salt Water. Now that you have proven yourself, I can share with you the final great secret.

Name: Shaman
AuditionLineA: This young man is staring off into the distance. He has a haunted look on his face.
AuditionLineB: Not my problem. It's time for you to man-up and do your job.
AuditionLineC: Well, up until just recently I was merely the underling of the village shaman. That was easy, I just had to follow his lead. Then he went for a drunken midnight swim in the Great Salt Water and, well, I suddenly found myself promoted. I didn't think it would be so bad. I figured I could just spout off some mystical mumbo-jumbo and everyone would be happy. But no. The very day that I acquire the title of shaman I find myself dealing with something that's way over my head.

Name: Kurisu
VoiceType: Kurisu is a young tribal woman
AuditionLineA: Sulik! [She catches herself and begins to whisper.] Do the spirits be teasing, or is that really you, brother?
AuditionLineB: Praise the spirits! Please, unlock this door. We eager to go from this evil place.
AuditionLineC: [Kurisu rushes to Sulik, who sweeps her up into an embrace. You turn away to give them some privacy during their emotional reunion. Several moments later, Kurisu turns to you with a grin as she wipes tears from her eyes.] Thank you, fren, for finding brother. Spirits got big plans for you and Sulik. He will be much missed, but the spirits say his place is walking by-and-by with you. Hell, even Grampy Bone like you, so I know Sulik in good hands. You take care.

Name: Amanda
VoiceType: Amanda is a young wife and mother camped in the Vault City courtyard
AuditionLineA: What do you want?
AuditionLineB: But it was an accident! I... he didn't mean to do it!
AuditionLineC: I don't want my son to be raised as a slave! We came to Vault City because we heard it was a free city... but we get here... and there's all these laws, and payments to the guards and... it's nothing like what we were told.

Name: Doctor Andrew
VoiceType: Andrew isn't really a doctor — he operates a loaner Auto-Doc ("the ol' Doctor") out of a back room and charges for the privilege. Scruffy
AuditionLineA: Looks like you've seen some fighting, friend. You here to get patched up?
AuditionLineB: Well, technically, "high thermal" is standard Phoenix Armor with some thermal dissipaters layered over the membranes.
AuditionLineC: I hope to heaven you can hear me right now. Look, when you regain feeling in your extremities, you'll feel an incredible itching sensation all over. Don't scratch! If you do, those pus-crusts over the drainage incisions'll burst and leave scars. Give 'em a few weeks to heal, okay?

Name: Barkus
AuditionLineA: What th--?! A mutant! In Vault City! Guards! Guards!
AuditionLineB: That's all I needed to know then, thanks. Good day.
AuditionLineC:
Very well. Your Servant has been relocated for medical testing and re-conditioning.
 Curious... the Servant seemed quite surprised by the whole affair. It took a few tranquilizer
 darts to smooth things over. I put everything the Servant was carrying in the box in my office.

Name: John Cassidy
AuditionLineA: Well, now. I ain't seen you around before, stranger. Name's Cassidy. I run this place. What can I do for you?
AuditionLineB: Step outta line, Myron, and I'm gonna cut you.
AuditionLineC: It gets better. Now I'm in debt to the guards for the fine, an' I had to buy a new case of alcohol from a merchant at triple my standard rate. I'm expecting the guards to come knocking again soon, just to bust my chops.

Name: Connar
AuditionLineA: Hey you! What're you doing here?!
AuditionLineB: I didn't know this was why they wanted the job done.
AuditionLineC:
Well, it's kind of a strange story. You see, a bunch of ghouls came here one day, mumbling something about a "renewal",
 and giving out these funky amulets. [He shows you an Ankh shaped amulet.] These big rodents came with em, and the ghouls said
 they'd be protecting us from now on. The ghouls left--probably back up to Gecko--but the rodents stayed put, and they've
 been here ever since. Like I said, it's pretty strange stuff. It's kind of a pain to clean up after these things, but hell,
 if they keep Vault City off our ass, then I suppose I can put up with a little rat shit.

Name: Doctor Troy
AuditionLineA: Let's see... we have three inoculation shots scheduled for tomorrow morning.
AuditionLineB: Yes. I just got my Citizenship papers only recently.
AuditionLineC:
No, really. They were originally growing hallucinogens in brahmin shit, but then they discovered
 that the *fumes* were actually making the workers high. See, it turns out there's this contaminated
 pre-war protein extract in the brahmin systems...

Name: Lydia
VoiceType: Vault City's bartender — brisk
AuditionLineA: Hey there, Chosen One! We were just talking about your adventure... can I get you anything to drink?
AuditionLineB: We're closed. Once I finish making the list of our stock, I'll be closing up.
AuditionLineC: It's a ways to the southwest. I hear conflicting reports about Reno. Some merchants, especially the slavers, really love it there. Other merchants... don't. City with a lot of glitter... and a lot of trouble, I hear.

Name: Gregory
AuditionLineA: For your act of bravery, you have been granted full access to Vault City. Oh... the First Citizen said she wanted to see you.
AuditionLineB: Compile form 5632 into the list server...
AuditionLineC: Well, let's take a look... first, let's see if... oh, very good, I see you got that one, how about... why yes, you carried the two, very clever, very clever... but why did you... oh, you applied the derivative to #5... brilliant!

Name: Happy Harry
AuditionLineA: Well, hello there... what can I do for you?
AuditionLineB: Thanks for the business. Take care.
AuditionLineC:
Working with Dave, eh? Yeah, I know the fella. I see he's still got a knack for getting others to do his leg work--lazy bastard.
 [He chuckles.] Anyway, I think I got what you're lookin for, but lemme just go back an' check. [Harry goes into his back room where you
 hear boxes being shuffled and moved around. He returns a minute later.] Yep, got it right here. $500 and she's all yours.

Name: Joanne Lynette
AuditionLineA: It is late. Schedule an appointment for tomorrow morning, and I will receive you then.
AuditionLineB: What happened to the Overseer? I must speak with him.
AuditionLineC:
Perhaps an important lesson can be learned here, Lynette. Isolated from the world, the
 government was prepared to destroy you without even recognizing the value of your community. Perhaps
 Vault City should take another look at the outside world... and its place in it.

Name: Valerie
AuditionLineA: Oh, hello, "Dad."
AuditionLineB: That metal lathe needs to be oiled again...
AuditionLineC: Yes, I'm SURE. Well... except for the fact that I think he should lose some weight. He's got quite a spare tire going. And he should stop wandering all around the wastes selling junk to tribals. That's pretty much it.

Name: McClure
AuditionLineA: I have heard of your act of heroism. We are all in your debt... Chosen One.
AuditionLineB: What can you tell me about the First Citizen?
AuditionLineC: Recruiting servants is not the issue here. The issue is the threat that these monsters pose to Vault City. According to Sergeant Stark's report, the people of that village seem to coexist with those huge rat creatures. If that's true, they may have found a way to control them, and perhaps that's why these creatures have begun to attack our patrols. Sergeant Stark plans to eliminate these pests, and he has my full support.

Name: Thomas Moore
AuditionLineA: Hello and welcome, traveler! Have you heard the word today?
AuditionLineB: If there is no trust between us, I shall leave. Goodbye.
AuditionLineC:
The NCR is trying to bring honor and government to all of California,
 and Vault City has the power to make it happen! Think of the good we could do with access to Vault
 City's technology!

Name: Phyllis
AuditionLineA: You risked your own life to save us ALL. You're the bravest person I've ever known.
AuditionLineB: Uh, yeah, I just recently got my Citizenship.
AuditionLineC: It's like they're all... clones. They all dress alike, act alike, and the worst part is that everybody seems happy with it. I... well, sometimes I worry that I'll end up being just like them. That probably sounds silly, huh?

Name: Old Joe
VoiceType: Old Joe's public face is a "crazy old beggar" act — rambling
AuditionLineA: Hello. Haven't seen you in a while.
AuditionLineB: Well, you better be careful around here. Things ain't as clear as they once were. You best watch your back.
AuditionLineC: [He barks gruff laughter for awhile; finally, he settles down and wipes a couple tears from his eyes.] Oh, that's rich. Burnt to death by a flame thrower, ha! You see, I told the Vault Dweller to make up some story about how I died, 'cause I didn't want any of our old enemies trying to hunt me down -- that's why I changed my name. I told him to have me going down in a blaze of glory, and it looks like he took that literally. Ha, that's classic.

Name: Stark
AuditionLineA: Good job down south. Saw the fireworks all the way up here.
AuditionLineB: Need to compile those ammunition lists...
AuditionLineC: Excellent. Here, let me show you the exact location of the village. [Stark marks the village on your Pip-Boy map.] Pay's $750, just come back and collect once you finish the task. One more thing -- if you don't deal with it in a month, I'll send a squad there to eliminate the monsters... and any other threat.

Name: Wallace
AuditionLineA: We have heard about your heroic exploits. By order of the Council, you... and any companions... are permitted to enter Vault City whenever you wish.
AuditionLineB: I changed my mind. I'm not telling you anything.
AuditionLineC: Well... this certainly seems to be a matter for the First Citizen. Here is your Day Pass. It is only good during the day - at night you will be asked to leave the city. Citizens also reserve the right to cancel the Day Pass privileges at any time, so behave yourself.

Name: Ann
VoiceType: Ann is a young woman busy cooking for the fledgling Vault Village community. She's warm and grateful early on — genuinely relieved the village survived Vault City's attempts to reclaim them. When she asks the PC for a favor (getting a caravan to trade with the village)
AuditionLineA: Why hello there, I'm Connar's wife, Ann. You must be the one who helped us out. I can't tell you how much we appreciate all you've done. It's hard to believe that we can finally live in peace without fear of Vault City's goons coming to take us from our homes.
AuditionLineB: We have the right to live here, you know.
AuditionLineC: Actually, I *could* use some help. Now that we're becoming more organized, we're starting to see our numbers grow. The problem is, I'm not sure we'll have enough food to go around. My husband has attempted to get the caravans to stop here, but they don't' think we're worth their time. I don't suppose you could get them to reconsider?

Name: Skynet
AuditionLineA: A nice piece of engineering that further blurs the boundary between humans and robots.
AuditionLineB: Remain here. I'll be back.
AuditionLineC: Skynet thanks the human.                                            Skynet wishes to ask favor.                                        Skynet wishes to travel with human.

Name: Private Dobbs
AuditionLineA: He looks healthy, but seems quite disoriented.
AuditionLineB: What happened next?
AuditionLineC: The next thing I remember was seeing my body as if I was looking down at it from above. I heard the doctors say I was dead and then they threw my body onto a pile of other bodies.
